From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, Jan 14, 2026 at 5:42 PM PT
Subject: AWS Marketplace submission call + portal access (Redwood Inference)

Hi Derek,

We’re aiming to submit the refreshed listing + new SKU set early next week and wanted to lock a 30-min submission/review call.

Could you share availability for Tue 1/20 or Wed 1/21 (PT)? A few options that work for us:
- Tue 1/20 10:00–10:30am PT
- Tue 1/20 2:00–2:30pm PT
- Wed 1/21 11:00–11:30am PT

Also: we’re still sorting AWS Marketplace Management Portal access for a couple folks on our side (so we can actually hit “Submit” without scrambling day-of). Can you confirm if there are any AWS-side requirements for who must be present (role-wise) on the call?

Thanks,
Lauren

—
Lauren Bishop
Product Manager, Dedicated
Redwood Inference


From: Derek Thompson <dthompson@amazon.com>

Hi Lauren,

Tue 1/20 2:00–2:30pm PT works.

Re: access—on the call, we typically need someone who can navigate the Marketplace Management Portal and confirm the final listing fields (offer name/visibility, pricing model, fulfillment method, and the support contacts). If you’re using a delegated admin, that’s fine.

Please send:
1) attendee list + emails
2) whether you’ll use Chime or your own conferencing link

Best,
Derek

Derek Thompson
Partner Development Manager, AWS Marketplace

From: Derek Thompson <dthompson@amazon.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, aws-mp-ops@amazon.com
Date: Thu, Jan 15, 2026 at 10:12 AM PT
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace submission call + portal access (Redwood Inference)

Zoom is fine.

On portal roles: AWS can’t assign roles within your seller account from our side. You’ll need your internal account admin to grant the appropriate permissions in the Marketplace Management Portal.

At minimum, you’ll want whoever is submitting to have full offer management permissions. If you’re not seeing the “Submit for review” workflow, that usually indicates insufficient permissions.

No special invite template required. If you have your Seller ID handy, it’s helpful to include in the invite notes.

I’ll send a calendar invite for Tue 1/20 2:00–2:30pm PT.

Best,
Derek

Portal link: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/

Lauren
